messages:
Nina: Follow-up on warmup RFC: proposing a thin handoff for layer priorities so coordinator doesn't need the full loader contract.
Jose: Outline?
Nina: Loaders expose a Summaries endpoint returning coarse layer summaries (est_access_rate, est_size, variant_tag). Coordinator runs scoring. Optionally, coordinator can request LayerDetail for top candidates.
Arun: Important: include schema_version and provenance for compatibility. Also include sampling rules to limit CP load.
Maya: For quant variants we need variant multipliers. Also add a recompute_cost hint when fusion affects runtime.
warmup-bot: NOTE: keep Summaries p50 < 1ms to avoid regressions.
Jose: Fallback plan if we time out: fall back to static heuristics (largest layers then KV-prefix). Log fallback_metric.
Nina: I'll draft a short RFC with proto, scoring pseudocode, sampling strategy, and a tiny simulator. Loaders opt-in.
Arun: I can mock the proto and run latency probes on staging.
Maya: I'll produce a table of variant multipliers and review the PR.
Nina: cool — will land initial PR as WARMUP-5001.
